LegendX Hub V4 — Complete Overview & Script Documentation
LegendX Hub V4 is an all-in-one utility script specifically engineered for Slap Battles on Roblox. Built with a focus on seamless performance, responsiveness, and maximum player advantage, LegendX Hub combines advanced combat automation, anti-ragdoll protection, extended visuals, and movement modifications into a sleek, user-friendly interface.
Whether you are looking to farm slaps, dominate the arena, or safeguard yourself from falling into the void, LegendX Hub V4 provides a stable and non-intrusive solution for every player.
Key System Setup
To ensure secure distribution and keep the hub functional across the latest Roblox updates, LegendX Hub uses an integrated Key Verification System.
How to Access:
Execute the main Lua code in your executor.
When the LegendX Key System menu pops up, click "Get Key" to copy the official authorization link directly to your clipboard.
Open the link in your web browser, retrieve the access key, paste it into the key box, and click "Verify Key".
Once verified, the primary control panel will unlock automatically.
Detailed Module Breakdown
1. Main & Core Protections
Master Switch: Global safety toggle that immediately enables or disables all active modules across all tabs.
SB Anti-Ragdoll (Slap Fix): Intercepts and clears ragdoll physics, physics-lock scripts, and stun states upon being slapped. Allows your character to recover instantly and remain standing.
GodMode (Immunity): Continuously restores character health to maximum values, drastically reducing vulnerability during intense combat.
Anti-Void System: Continuously checks your character's height (Y-axis). If you fall off the main island or get knocked toward the void (Y < -30), it instantly resets your momentum and teleports you back onto the arena surface.
2. Combat & Automation
Slap Aura: Detects all opposing players within a customizable radius around your character and automatically triggers your equipped glove to slap them.
Follow Player: Identifies the nearest target on the server and continuously locks your character's position directly behind them, allowing for effortless slap farming.
Auto Clicker: Automatically triggers your equipped tool at maximum execution speeds without requiring manual mouse clicks.
E-Ability Spam: Continuously simulates high-frequency presses of the E hotkey to activate glove abilities instantly off cooldown.
Hitbox Expander: Scales up the physical detection box (HumanoidRootPart) of surrounding players, making it significantly easier to connect slaps from extended distances.
3. Visuals & ESP
ESP Chams (Highlight Visuals): Renders a high-visibility color highlight around all enemy character models, making players clearly visible through walls, obstacles, and map terrain.
4. Movement & Utility
SpeedHack: Overrides default character locomotion speeds to let you outrun opponents or close gaps rapidly.
Noclip: Disables collision on your character's body parts, enabling movement through map barriers, walls, and player collisions.
Infinite Jump: Enables unrestricted airborne jumps by resetting jump states mid-air on keypress.
SafeZone TP: A one-click utility button that instantly moves your character to a remote coordinate high above the map to recover health or avoid danger.
Interface Controls
Left Control (LeftCtrl): Default global keybind to show or hide the main hub interface.
